undated_mentions: Attended the Viktoria-Schule in Essen, a girls' grammar school with progressive teaching
Studied at Bauhaus Weimar under Johannes Itten, Lyonel Feininger, Paul Klee and Georg Muche
Worked without matriculation in the Bauhaus Dessau stage workshop under Oskar Schlemmer
Designed costumes and sets for the Bauhaus plays Ojdar and Circus
Wrote articles for the Moskauer Rundschau during the Moscow stay
Created collages and ink paintings of Moscow street life during the Moscow stay
Exhibited with Berlin artist colleagues for several years at Haus am Waldsee, Berlin-Zehlendorf
Accompanied Hinnerk Scheper on Norddeutsche Reportage-Reisen and wrote texts for his landscape photo series
Picture stories later published as children's books by Ernst Wunderlich after World War II
Experienced the end of the war with her children and parents in Badbergen
Colour design of interiors for Otto Bartning's last project, Berlin Philharmonic Hall, Egyptian Museum, Gropius buildings in Britz, Buckow and Rudow, and Berlin Tegel Airport
Worked on colour concepts for Scharoun's Berlin State Library until her death
